documents.text:
# Control testing and exceptions

## Overdue reviews
A control review not completed by its due date is overdue. An overdue review is escalated to the head of risk after 10 business days, and the control is rated not tested until the review is done.

## Exceptions
An exception to a control is approved for at most 90 days. It names a compensating control and an owner, and is reviewed again before it ends.

## Failed tests
A control that fails testing gets an issue with an owner and a fix date within 5 business days.
